item.tib: bon skyong spyi bsang udapal rgyas 'phreng gi mngon rtogs 'dod gsol
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di ni dge bstan pa ye shes nas/ 'di ltar dgos zhes rtse gcig tu mos pa'i bskul bar brten/ mkhan ming pa nyi ri shel zhin du 'bod pas/ sman ri'i bla brang du dge sbyor thun mtshams su sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/
